retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast 1980s music aesthetic featuring a subject bathed in magenta and cyan light against a deep navy background with wide-tracked geometric typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical composition featuring a female figure on the left side illuminated by vibrant magenta and cyan gels, set against a dark, textured navy blue void. The right side is dominated by negative space containing a large, expressive hand-drawn initial and wide-tracked, clean sans-serif text.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned on the left third with high-key magenta highlights
Deep navy blue background providing high contrast for white and cyan elements
Large gestural initial overlapping the main horizontal text line
Diagonal corner banner in the top right providing secondary metadata
coreInvariants: Dual-tone magenta and cyan lighting on the primary subject
Extreme horizontal tracking on all sans-serif typography
Deep navy blue or midnight blue background field

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left 40% of the frame, full-body or three-quarter length.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, magenta hand-drawn initial 'Q' serves as the central focal point for the text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the brightly lit subject on the left to the large initial, then across the horizontal text to the top-right corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space on the right half of the image to allow typography to breathe.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cyan/Light Blue (Secondary lighting and small text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in highlights against very low value, dark background.

letterConstructionRules: Integration of a gestural, hand-drawn element for the first letter
characterSpecificRedesigns: The initial letter is replaced by a thick, circular brush-stroke graphic that mimics the letter's shape.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monospace-style tracking applied to a single geometric sans-serif family, paired with a singular expressive graphic element.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric 80s aesthetic and monolinear weight.
Provides the necessary geometric skeleton for wide tracking.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photo of a person on the left side of the frame, lit with strong magenta and cyan gels, against a dark navy blue background with a slight film grain texture. Leave the right side of the frame as empty dark space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, hand-drawn magenta circular gesture in the center-right. Overlay white, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif text horizontally across the gesture. Add cyan stacked text in the upper right and a diagonal blue banner in the top right corner with white text.

verificationChecks: Is the tracking on the main text extremely wide?
Is the subject lit with both magenta and cyan?
Is the background a consistent dark navy?
Does the large initial have a hand-drawn, painterly texture?

mustRedesign: Do not replicate the exact facial features of the subject
Ensure the hand-drawn initial is a unique vector shape
postGenerationChecks: Check that text is legible despite wide tracking
Verify the magenta and cyan colors are vibrant
Ensure the subject is strictly on the left third
Confirm the background is dark enough to make white text pop
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Subject with Magenta/Cyan Gels] + [Navy Blue Negative Space] + [Wide-Tracked Geometric Sans Serif] + [Gestural Graphic Initial]
